description: This file defines a final class `JSON` providing utility methods for creating and manipulating JSON data, including parsing from various sources, converting objects to JSON strings, and deserializing JSON to objects. It uses Jackson's ObjectMapper and is part of the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to handle JSON data, including creation from input sources, conversion to objects, and checking equality based on JSON string content.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a JSON instance from an InputStream, assuming UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a JSON instance from a generic object by serializing it to a JSON string.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a JSON instance from a Reader source.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a JSON instance directly from a JSON-formatted string.

methods.name: toObject
methods.description: Deserializes the stored JSON string into an object of the specified class type.
